active_desc.en: $active$: Once activated, a crisis applies its own unique modifiers for a period of #l 2 years.#!

critical_desc.en: $critical$: You have one year to rebuild your central bank’s metallic reserves through measures such as massive foreign currency sales, direct state recapitalization, or securing international loans for the central bank.

stabilizing_desc.en: $stabilizing$: If no crisis occurs for an entire year, both the Economic Instability and Crisis counters will be reset — but only if the nation #l is not at war.#!

status_economic_crisis_1.en: #p Economic Stability #!is supporting steady national growth.

status_economic_crisis_2.en: #gold Economic Slowdown #!is weakening production and trade activity.

status_economic_crisis_3.en: #N Economic Crisis #!is severely disrupting the national economy.

status_currency_crisis_1.en: \n#p Monetary Stability #!is maintaining confidence in the national currency.

status_currency_crisis_2.en: \n#gold Currency Instability #!is beginning to pressure monetary markets.

status_currency_crisis_3.en: \n#N Currency Crisis #!is actively destabilizing the national currency.

status_financial_crash_1.en: \n#p Financial Stability #!is maintaining healthy market conditions.

status_financial_crash_2.en: \n#gold Financial Instability #!is spreading through financial markets.

status_financial_crash_3.en: \n#N Financial Crash #!is causing widespread market disruption.

status_central_bank_bankruptcy_1.en: \n#p Central Banking Stability #!is ensuring monetary confidence.

status_central_bank_bankruptcy_2.en: \n#gold Central Bank Distress #!we have one year to avoid bankruptcy.

status_central_bank_bankruptcy_3.en: \n#N Central Bank Bankruptcy #!has disrupted national monetary control.

status_country_bankruptcy_1.en: \n#p Fiscal Stability #!is maintaining sustainable state finances.

status_country_bankruptcy_2.en: \n#gold Sovereign Debt Distress #!is increasing pressure on government finances.

status_country_bankruptcy_3.en: \n#N Country Bankruptcy #!has severely damaged state credibility and finances.

central_bank_bankruptcy_country_tooltip.en: #T #l Money Value in Gold:#! [GetPlayer.MakeScope.ScriptValue('money_value_in_gold')|D]@gold!#! \nThe current gold value of the national currency @gold! is #b [GetPlayer.MakeScope.ScriptValue('money_value_in_gold')|D]#! @gold!. If this value remains below #n 0.01#! @gold! for more than #bold 1 year#!, a #l #n Central Bank Bankruptcy#!#! may emerge. If the country is already experiencing economic or financial instability, dropping below #n 0.01#! @gold! will immediately trigger a #n multifactor economic crisis#!.\n > For #u 2 years#! the country will be in crisis and prevent the establishment of [concept_trade] routes (#u 3 years#! after the crisis, you could create a new currency).

currency_crisis_country_tooltip.en: #T #l Money Value over 1 Year:#! [GetPlayer.MakeScope.ScriptValue('money_value_dif_1_final')|%|=+]#! \nIf the value of the national currency declines by more than #n -50%#! within #bold 1 year#!, a #l #n Currency Crisis#!#! may emerge. If the country is already experiencing economic or financial instability, a monetary devaluation exceeding #n -50%#! will immediately trigger a #n multifactor economic crisis#!.\n > For #u 2 years#! the country will be in crisis and prevent the establishment of [concept_trade] routes (#u 3 years#! after the crisis, you could create a new currency).

economic_crisis_country_tooltip.en: #T #l [concept_gdp] over 1 Year:#! [GetPlayer.MakeScope.ScriptValue('GDP_dif_1_final')|%|=+]#! \nIf the national [concept_gdp] declines by more than #n -50%#! within #bold 1 year#!, an #l #n Economic Crisis#!#! may emerge. If the country is already experiencing economic or financial instability, an economic contraction exceeding #n -50%#! will immediately trigger a #n multifactor economic crisis#!.\n > For #u 2 years#! #t all buildings#! in the country will receive a modifier that will decrease their productivity by more than #N 50%#!.

financial_crash_country_tooltip.en: #T #l Stock Market Index Variation over 1 Year:#! [GetPlayer.MakeScope.ScriptValue('GDP_dif_1_final')|%|=+]#! \nIf the national stock market index declines by more than #n -50%#! within #bold 1 year#!, a #l #n Financial Crash#!#! may emerge. If the country is already experiencing economic or financial instability, a market collapse exceeding #n -50%#! will immediately trigger a #n multifactor economic crisis#!.\n > For #u 2 years#! #t all private buildings#! in the country will receive a modifier that will decrease their productivity by more than #N 50%#!.

country_bankruptcy_tooltip.en: #T #l Country Bankruptcy:#!#! \n When the country declares bankruptcy, it enters a period of economic instability for the entire duration of the moddifier. While this is the least damaging major crisis to the economy, it creates a highly vulnerable environment in which any additional emerging crisis will immediately escalate into a #n multifactor economic crisis#!.
